summary: This document updates the IPv6 specification (RFC 2460) so tunnel protocols that use UDP over IPv6 can skip the UDP checksum in certain cases. This is allowed when the tunnel's header information is protected on the inner packet being carried. Skipping it avoids the computation cost and improves performance.

eli5.summary: Checking every package twice is slow. If the package inside is already checked, this lets the outer wrapper skip its check.

questions: can ipv6 udp checksum be zero
